systems.owner: Ministerio de Sanidad y Bienestar Social (MSBS)
systems.tiers: public hospitals are named as the source of births, deaths and causes of death reaching INEGE through the SNIS; a 'puesto de salud' appears only as a place of birth

note: INEGE's vital-events report for 2023 uses the SNIS as a source of hospital births and deaths and says vital-event variables are added to the register books of public hospitals and private clinics, reported to INEGE quarterly; it does not say how the SNIS itself collects or whether it is digital. TACE is INEGE's own processing application for vital-event forms, not a health information system. No fact.
